name: 1.23.0-beta.10
notes: Ren'Py games: a camera button while playing takes a picture of the screen and keeps it in the game's own screenshots gallery (made the first time).
Mods can be switched while playing: the mods button saves the game, starts it again with the mods you chose and puts you back where you were.

Big games (over 300 MB) load their pictures and sounds as the story needs them, using Ren'Py's own look-ahead, instead of reading the whole game into memory at the start: they open much faster and use far less memory. A game's page has a setting for this (Automatic, As needed, All at the start). Picture sizes are measured once, the first time.
